title: Italy's Budget Balancing Act: Growth Hopes and Fiscal Risks Test Meloni's… · 15 Sep
keywords: Italy, budget, Meloni, fiscal policy, EU deficit rules, inflation, GDP growth, bank levy, eurozone, League, Bank of Italy, Eurostat, European affairs, public spending, tax cuts
notes: Italy's government is pressing ahead with a spending plan that combines tax cuts, security outlays, and energy measures while leaning on an upgraded growth forecast to justify the arithmetic. But independent data tells a more cautious story, with GDP growth projected at just 0.6% for 2026 and inflation edging back up to 3.2% in August. The stakes extend well beyond Rome, touching EU fiscal discipline, eurozone confidence, and the daily economic pressures facing ordinary Italians.
